supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic HTTPS activity is attributed to C:\Program Files\RouteWise\routewiseupd.exe, which contacted update.routewise.com through the explicit proxy. The process start and correlated network records support this attribution. [T126-00133, T126-00135, T126-00136, T126-00138]

The observed destination and cadence match the inventory's approved RouteWise updater behavior, which checks update.routewise.com about every five minutes; this supports a benign explanation for the alerted activity. [T126-00133, T126-00135, T126-00198, T126-00223, T126-00256, T126-00263, T126-00287, T126-00298]

known_telemetry_limitations: The cited RouteWise proxy records show HTTPS CONNECT tunnel metadata and byte counts, not the encrypted request or response contents; they do not establish what the updater checked or whether it installed an update. [T126-00135, T126-00198, T126-00223, T126-00256, T126-00263, T126-00287, T126-00298]
No cited record establishes the updater binary's signature, hash, or integrity.
claims_not_established: The contents or outcome of the RouteWise HTTPS exchanges are not established by the available tunnel metadata.
The evidence does not establish that the updater downloaded or installed software, or that the binary was unmodified.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: Chrome accessed customer.cloud.com/Citrix/StoreWeb, including a POST to a StoreWeb resources endpoint. This is outside the alerted RouteWise activity; the records establish the web requests, not that remote access or data transfer occurred. [T126-00160, T126-00161, T126-00169, T126-00170, T126-00172]

Separate review: DC-COP-01 recorded an authentication for kim.nguyen from WS-DREYES-01, followed by a network logon to WS-KNGUYEN-01 from that workstation. This is unrelated to the RouteWise connections and warrants validation. [T126-00213, T126-00214]
Separate review: kim.nguyen launched PowerShell with ExecutionPolicy Bypass to run C:\Scripts\backup-check.ps1. The records do not establish the script's contents or purpose. [T126-00189, T126-00190]
